target: Add a small, dependency-free gate client (`src/dopemux/claude/dispatch_gate.py`) that resolves the project key and gate path, runs the gate with a timeout, and maps its exit code to a typed result. No hook wiring.
invariants:
I01 Gate contract is pinned to dispatch-desk a025bb5 (tools/gate.py, tools/ledger.py): `gate.py check --project

[--task ] --by `; exit 0 GO, 3 pause requested, 4 unapproved (only with --require-approval), 2 bad usage.

I02 The gate is an external, optional tool. Gate path is `$DISPATCH_DESK_HOME/tools/gate.py`, default `~/code/dispatch-desk/tools/gate.py`. If the file is absent the hook does nothing and prints nothing.

I03 Project key is the MAIN checkout folder name (`dopemux-mvp`), derived from `git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir`, never the worktree folder name. It must equal the ledger key the desk uses.

I04 Declared effect outside the repo: when a pause is requested the gate appends `pause_acknowledged` to `~/.dispatch-desk/ledger.jsonl` (or `$DISPATCH_DESK_LEDGER`). This repo writes nothing else outside itself and never writes the ledger directly.

I05 Advisory only (owner decision D2): on exit 3 the hook adds context telling the runner a pause is requested and to stop and report. It never denies a tool call and never exits non-zero because of the gate.
I06 Fail open (owner decision D1): gate missing, timeout (2 s), exit 2 or any unexpected exit lets work continue; at most one line of context says the gate state is UNKNOWN.
I07 `--require-approval` is not passed. With an empty ledger it would return 4 for every task.
I08 Existing hook behaviour is unchanged when the gate is absent: the existing native-hook tests pass unmodified apart from added cases.
The client has no import-time side effects and does not import anything outside the standard library.

requirements: Read only. Do not edit dispatch-desk.

steps.task: Write the client and its tests
requirements: Public surface: `resolve_project(root) -> str`, `resolve_gate() -> Path | None`, `check(root, by, task=None, timeout=2.0) -> GateResult` with state in {GO, PAUSE_REQUESTED, UNAPPROVED, NOT_INSTALLED, UNKNOWN} and the gate message.
Standard library only. Run the gate as `python3 -I <gate> check ...` via subprocess with a list argv; never a shell string.
Tests use a fake gate script in a temp dir selected through DISPATCH_DESK_HOME, and a temp ledger through DISPATCH_DESK_LEDGER. Tests never touch `~/.dispatch-desk`.
Test matrix: exit 0, 3, 4, 2, unexpected exit, timeout, gate absent, project key from a linked worktree equals the main checkout name.
validation: no write outside the temp dir (assert the real ledger path is untouched or absent)
